approval.per_entry_flags: LAYOUT_APPROVED covers every anchor, zone, water element and sightline below; their approved flags were set true at the freeze.
approval.unfreeze_rule: The frozen Macro Layout changes only for a measured, reproducible gameplay or terrain blocker, and only after the user re-reviews it.

next_gate: P5 Hero Assets (Human Village V2 phases P0–P13 are the only official phase numbers). P1 Terrain, P2 Water, P3 Roads / Parcels and P4 Greybox are ART_APPROVED and closed; every generator change must keep the Macro Layout freeze, the P1 Approved Terrain Protection Gate, the P2 water gate, the P3 roads / parcels gate, the P4 greybox gate, the progressive-reveal dragon sightline gate and all P1 regression tests green (godot/tools/run_village_v2_regression.sh). Carried into P5: LANDMARK_TOWER 7×7×18 m solid placeholder. Master spec: docs/plans/人間之里V2全面重製計畫.md.

user_rulings.ruling: Main street bends right/east from the market and terminates at the dragon-statue bridge, not straight to the shrine hill.
Farmland on the east side is correct.
Village channels were untidy; make them regular and aligned.
Western residential zone sat too far north; move it south.

The main street runs unbroken from the south grand torii to the dragon-statue bridge; buildings and market line both sides of it. West of it: residential plus small channel branches. East of it: farmland and the main river. The north shrine is reached by a small lane out of the commercial belt, or by looping round to the back and climbing.
Main street W80 (7.20 m) adopted; r2 north-hill terrain passes; temporary canopy stays until P9 Vegetation; no further Macro changes to main street, north hill or main river.
LAYOUT_APPROVED: freeze v2-layout-0.3 with W80 / 7.20 m as the approved P0 World Layout. Dragon Base stays a placeholder; shoreline integration deferred. Next phase: P1 Terrain.

P1 Terrain ART_APPROVED (commit 59cedbc). No further P1 Terrain changes; the Dragon Bridge east-bank polish area is not widened. South-gate soft shoulder goes to P4 retaining structure; 9-step farm macro elevation stays, visible bunds go to P8. All P1 regression tests stay mandatory. Next phase: P2 Water.

P2 Water may change only below-waterline riverbed (main river, canal, west stream), depth / thalweg distribution, the water-surface mesh, and a narrow shoreline seam (waterline ±0.20–0.30 m or within 1–2 m of the bank). P1-approved above-waterline macro terrain and bank silhouette are protected (|Δh| ≤ 0.03 m outside the seam mask). Main-river depth follows river form (outer bend deep, inner bend shallow, straight-reach channel), no random noise; the canal stays engineered; the west stream gets natural pool/riffle variation.
P2 Water ART_APPROVED (commit 034d5e4). Keep all P1/P2 gates; no further shoreline visual polish. Next phase: P3 Roads / Parcels, following the master spec order.

P3 lanes: a separate P3 lane layer (layout_v2.json `lanes`, outside the freeze; frozen roads and freeze SHA untouched). Lanes stay inside built platforms, 2.0–3.0 m wide, with turns; the surface drapes the P1 platform with no grading (P1 protection ≤ 0.03 m).

P3 parcels: one parcel per building. Machiya frontage about 5–9 m, depth 12–25 m, generated deterministically from the frontage; landmark buildings use fixed parcels. P4 greybox places one building per parcel.

P3 parcels r1 NOT approved, shallow-parcel correction only: the 47 infill parcels 8–12 m deep still counted as machiya, which violates the 12–25 m ruling and would push P4 to shrink buildings until the village looks like a model house. Keep the lanes; do not touch P0/P1. Merge those parcels into adjacent ones where possible, keeping machiya at 12–25 m; where merging is unreasonable, relabel them auxiliary/yard parcels (garden, storehouse, shed, backyard, open ground) that are NOT formal machiya building plots. Do not stuff buildings in to chase land coverage — about 4% of land far from a road is acceptable, a village should have backyards and gaps. Do not redo the rest of P3.

P3 parcels r2 result: machiya depth 12.0–25.0 m with zero shallow parcels (187 machiya, 14 of them deepened by merging, +80.0 m total); 38 auxiliary/yard parcels 8–12 m (kind `aux`, with a `use` field); 9 landmark parcels. Frontage coverage is now measured over BUILDABLE frontage only (a sample counts only if a minimum machiya 5 × 12 m fits there), so the metric can never be raised by adding shallow or auxiliary parcels.

P3 Roads / Parcels ART_APPROVED (commit a969e0a). Keep every P0–P3 gate. Enter P4 Greybox. The Suzunaan / Geidontei landmark bodies overlapping the main-street carriageway (0.27 / 0.52 m²) are solved in P4 greybox (setback or footprint), not by reopening the P0 freeze. Auxiliary parcels (kind `aux`) stay candidates for back yard, storehouse, shed, courtyard or open ground; they are not required to carry a building.
主街→龍神像視線改為漸進式揭露：硬 gate 移到終點接近區並計入全部建築；保留鯢吞亭實體灰盒；P4 調主街 D/H 與高度節奏（增加二階比例）。
P4 Greybox = ART_APPROVED。保留目前 massing、D/H（主街中位 1.76）與 progressive reveal sightline 設計，不再為了概念圖比例繼續提高整排建築。18 m 樓閣 placeholder 留 P5，洋紅線照既定階段處理。保留全部 P0–P4 regression gates，正式進入 P5 Hero Assets。
